target: Homepage guided exhibit, turning-point reader and randomness experiment

customReplacement.reason: Existing project styling with native anchors, select, disclosures and dedicated story readers; no modal runtime or new production dependency. Upstream card/modal patterns informed direction studies, not copied proprietary code. Auxiliary design-inspiration skill was unavailable; main design workflow governed the implementation.

contract.purpose: Help readers understand why another person's outcome cannot judge their own pace or worth.
contract.canonicalPurpose: A guided, credible explanation of conditions, perseverance, sequence, luck, and unobserved paths.
contract.audience: Readers who feel behind after comparing success at similar ages.
contract.job: Understand an unequal starting point, explore a real turning point, and leave with bounded agency.
contract.thesis: A compact guided exhibit makes conditions, choices and chance visible before inviting deeper reading.
contract.system: Midnight green, warm yellow, coral and pale sky section fields; strong sans display and book-serif moments; native controls.
contract.signature: A miniature life history, inherited jug preparation, situation-linked stories and an explicitly hypothetical random-draw experiment.
contract.risk: Breadth must not become a wealth gallery or a personal-probability simulator; keep opposing outcomes and explicit limits.
